{{Quote|I can take Lluda in my Y-wing. It’ll be a tight, uncomfortable ride, but we can fit.|Zorii Bliss|audio=TightFit-TheRiseOfSkywalkedExpandedEdition.flac|<ref name="TROS Expanded" />}}
The '''''Comeuppance''''', otherwise known as '''Zorii Bliss's Y-Wing''', was a modified [[BTA-NR2 Y-wing starfighter]] owned by [[Zorii Bliss]], leader of the [[Spice Runners of Kijimi]]. Bliss purchased the Y-wing for around 40,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] after the [[First Order]] began [[Occupation of Kijimi|raiding]] the [[planet]] [[Kijimi]] by [[33 ABY]]. In [[35 ABY]], Bliss escaped Kijimi in the ''Comeuppance'' before the [[Sith Eternal]] [[Destruction of Kijimi|destroyed]] the planet on the orders of [[Darth Sidious]], taking the [[droidsmith]] [[Babu Frik]] with her. She later joined up with the [[Resistance]] in the ''Comeuppance'' as a member of the [[Citizens' Fleet]] at the [[Battle of Exegol]].

==Description==
{{Quote|Grab your go-packs and scatter. Lluda, meet me at my Y-wing; you know where I park it, right?|Zorii Bliss, to her spice runners|audio=ParkComeuppance-TheRiseOfSkywalkedExpandedEdition.flac|<ref name="TROS Expanded" />}}
[[File:ComeuppanceCockpit-SWEDK.png|thumb|left|250px|Zorii Bliss in the cockpit of the ''Comeuppance'']]
[[Spicerunner|Spice runner]] Zorii Bliss's Y-Wing,<ref name="Topps2" /> named the ''Comeuppance'', was a modified [[BTA-NR2 Y-wing starfighter]] with an [[armor]]ed [[cockpit]] module whose canopy [[Zorii Bliss]] could remotely open with her [[helmet]]. She used technology in her helmet to assist her in combat when flying the [[BTL Y-wing starfighter|Y-wing]].<ref name="Guide">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Galactic Guide]]''</ref> The ''Comeuppance'' had an upgraded [[navigation computer]] and a customizable tactical interface. The [[Starship|ship]] stored a [[Standard week|week's]] worth of provisions.<ref name="TROS Expanded" /> The ship had two [[ion turbine]] [[engine]]s,<ref name="Starfighters" /> a [[Comm unit|communication system]],<ref name="TROS" /> a [[hyperdrive]],<ref name="TROS Expanded" /> and featured two [[IX4-B laser cannon]]s.<ref name="SWGOH" /> The ship's [[hull]] was [[Color|white]] with a red pattern. The engine featured six bars, one of which was a light-blue while the others were white.<ref name="Topps2" />

==History==
===Plans to avoid the First Order===
{{Quote|Can't stand the cries anymore. I've saved up enough to get out. I'm going to the Colonies.|Zorri Bliss, to Poe Dameron|<ref name="TROS" />}}
[[File:ZoriiBliss-TROSposter.png|thumb|right|250px|Zorii Bliss purchased the ''Comeuppance'' for around 40,000 credits.]]
The [[starfighter]], like all BTA-NR2 Y-wings, was manufactured by [[Koensayr Manufacturing]] sometime after the [[Declaration of a New Republic|formation]] of the [[New Republic]] began<ref name="StarfightersBased" /> in [[4 ABY]].<ref name="Create">''[[Rebel Starfighters Owners' Workshop Manual]]'' states the [[BTA-NR2 Y-wing starfighter]] was created after the [[New Republic]] [[Declaration of a New Republic|began]] to form, which ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates to [[4 ABY]].</ref> After the [[First Order]] began [[Occupation of Kijimi|raiding]] the [[planet]] [[Kijimi]] by [[33 ABY]],<ref name="RaidDate">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|IX}} to [[35 ABY]]. ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' states the [[First Order]] [[Occupation of Kijimi|raided]] the [[planet]] [[Kijimi]] for [[Standard year|years]], therefore meaning the raids began by [[33 ABY]].</ref> Bliss, who led the [[Spice Runners of Kijimi]], formulated a two-pronged plan to escape to the [[Colonies]]: find a ship and secure safe passage. She spent around 40,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] on the modified BTA-NR2 Y-wing<ref name="TROS Expanded" />—which sold for 95,000 credits used<ref name="RebelsStar">''[[Rebel Starfighters Owners' Workshop Manual]]''</ref>—and acquired a [[First Order transit data-medallion|First Order Captain's Medallion]]. Though others thought ill of naming starfighters, she called her Y-wing the ''Comeuppance''; Bliss felt she had a lot of scores to settle. The spice runner left the ship parked in a ravine outside [[Kijimi City]] and hidden under a [[Water|snow]] tarp.<ref name="TROS Expanded" />

In [[35 ABY]],<ref name="35ABY">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|IX}} to [[35 ABY]].</ref> Bliss [[Mission to Kijimi|assisted]] the [[Resistance]] by giving her Captain's Medallion to her old friend [[Poe Dameron]] and his companions. After discovering the First Order sought to punish Resistance sympathizers on Kijimi, Bliss returned to the [[Spice Runners' Den]] to command the Spice Runners to evacuate the [[city]]. Bliss volunteered to take fellow spice runner [[Lluda]] in her Y-wing, admitting it would be a tight fit, to which the [[Gender|girl]] thanked her. After a [[Urban Assault Triped Transport|walker]] forced its way through the den's front door, Bliss commanded the runners to grab their go-packs and flee. She ordered Lluda to meet her at her Y-wing, confirming the girl knew where she parked the ship before escaping through the [[Monastery (cantina)|Monastery]] herself.<ref name="TROS Expanded" />

===Putting the plans into motion===
{{Quote|Down with the First Order! Long live the Resistance!|Lluda causing a distraction so Zorii Bliss can reach the ''Comeuppance''|audio=LongLiveTheResistance-TheRiseOfSkywalkedExpandedEdition.flac|<ref name="TROS Expanded" />}}
[[File:Ushar-StarWarsEncyclopedia.png|thumb|left|250px|Ushar blocked Zorii Bliss's path to the ''Comeuppance''.]]
Bliss realized she could no longer escape to the Colonies without the Medallion but could still leave Kijimi with the ''Comeuppance''. As she pondered where she should go with the ship, she was comforted by her week's worth of provisions on board, though she recalled Lluda would be joining her, cutting the provisions in half. After Bliss reached one of the city's outer walls, she discovered a unit of [[First Order snowtrooper|snowtroopers]] and [[Ushar]], a [[Knights of Ren|Knight of Ren]], stood between her and the ravine where she had left the ''Comeuppance''. Bliss planned to detonate a [[neehwa oil]] [[lantern]] inside a nearby observation tower and reach her starfighter in the chaos.<ref name="TROS Expanded" />

After setting the [[lamp]] to explode and reaching a safe distance, Bliss activated the [[detonator]]. However, the First Order party stayed in its location. As Bliss voiced her frustration, Lluda surprised her with a tap on her shoulder. The girl suggested she would distract the [[trooper]]s while Bliss made it to the ''Comeuppance''. Though Bliss protested and insisted they could escape together, Lluda ran off and began shouting at the snowtroopers, prompting the unit and Ushar to give chase after the girl. Bliss ran for her ship, a difficult task with the shin-deep snow.<ref name="TROS Expanded" />

===Battle of Exegol===
{{Dialogue|Bliss|So long, sky trash!|Dameron|Who's that flyer?|Bliss|Take a guess, spice runner.|Frik|[Babu Frik whoops]|line4=no|attr=Zorii Bliss, Poe Dameron, and Babu Frik|audio=SoLongSkytrash-TheRiseOfSkywalker.flac|src=<ref name="TROS" />}}
Bliss was relieved that the ladder to the Y-wing remained as she moved under the tarp. She climbed up the ladder and triggered the cockpit to open with her helmet. Once inside, she triggered the [[Power converter|converters]], pumped the [[fuel]] line, and activated the [[repulsorlift]] for a quick takeoff, hoping the First Order could not follow her. Bliss maneuvered for a safer path as the Y-wing shook from [[blaster]] fire pelting her [[Deflector shield|shields]]. Bliss pondered returning to Kijimi City after escaping through [[hyperspace]] to find members of her crew but was unsure where to go after that. As the ''Comeuppance'' exited Kijimi's [[atmosphere]], Bliss forgave Dameron for running to the Resistance and decided she would also run to something. Later, as the [[Xyston-class Star Destroyer|''Xyston''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Derriphan]]'' activated its [[Axial superlaser|superlaser]] on Kijimi, under orders from<ref name="TROS Expanded" /> the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]]<ref name="Battles">''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]''</ref> [[Darth Sidious]], Bliss went to the [[droidsmith]] [[Babu Frik]]'s [[Babu Frik's workshop|workshop]] to retrieve him before the planet's [[Destruction of Kijimi|destruction]].<ref name="TROS Expanded" />

[[File:Comeuppance-BTA-NR2Y-wingExpansion.png|thumb|right|270px|Zorii Bliss destroyed a ''Xyston''-class Star Destroyer with the ''Comeuppance''.]]
When Resistance [[General]] [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] and member [[Chewbacca]] issued a call-to-arms against the [[Sith Eternal]]'s [[fleet]], the [[Final Order]], on the planet [[Exegol]],<ref name="TROS" /> Bliss answered the call and joined the [[Citizens' Fleet]]<ref name="Bust">{{BustCollectionCite|70|Star Wars Universe}}</ref> in the ''Comeuppance'' with Frik as a passenger and<ref name="TROS" /> the [[R5 series astromech droid]]<ref name="R5">''[[Rebel Starfighters Owners' Workshop Manual]]''</ref> [[K3-R1]]<ref name="TSS">''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]''</ref> in the ship's [[astromech socket]]. After the Citizens' Fleet destroyed the ''Xyston''-class [[Star Destroyer]]<ref name="TROS" /> ''[[Sutta]]'',<ref name="Battles" /> Bliss pelted the [[cannon]] of another Sith Star Destroyer with the ''Comeuppance''{{'s}} [[laser cannon]]s. She barrel-rolled through the explosion and soared past [[Black One (35 ABY)|Poe Dameron's X-wing fighter]],<ref name="TROS" /> replicating his maneuvers and destroying [[TIE/dg starfighter]]s before him.<ref name="Jr">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: A Junior Novel]]''</ref> Dameron inquired who was flying the Y-wing, to which Bliss responded along with Frik.<ref name="TROS" /> Bliss then [[Transmitter|transmitted]] targeting data to the other starships in the Citizens' Fleet.<ref name="Battles" /> After the [[Battle of Exegol]] concluded with a victory for the Resistance, some members of the Citizens' Fleet returned to the [[Resistance base (Ajan Kloss)|Resistance base]] on the [[moon]] [[Ajan Kloss]] with the remaining Resistance ships. Bliss was among those that celebrated on Ajan Kloss.<ref name="TROS Expanded" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Development===
{{Quote|So this is the first full-size Y-wing that's been made in ''Star Wars'' since 1976, for ''Star Wars''. This is an update to that version which was obviously a Colin Cantwell model Joe Johnston designed. I wanted to go back to the inspiration of the Ralph McQuarrie more rocket ship feeling ones that he did that was part Colin Cantwell part Ralph. And so, again, it's more retro, it's sleeker, it's more rounded off, new nacelle. It's much longer.|Production designer Kevin Jenkins|audio=Comeuppance-AFinalAlliance.flac|<ref name="Final">{{HomeVideoCite|set=Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker (Target Exclusive)|featurette=A Final Alliance}}</ref>}}
The ''Comeuppance'' first appeared in the [[sequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']],<ref name="TROS" /> which released on [[December 20]], [[2019]].<ref name="Jedi Redeemed">{{InsiderCite|196|The Jedi Redeemed: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker|The Jedi Redeemed: ''Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker''}}</ref> The Y-wing was first pictured on [[September 26]], earlier that year, in a preview for the "Resistance Y-Wing Starfighter" [[LEGO]] set, which was released on [[October 4]].<ref name="Triple">{{SW|url=news/triple-force-friday-products|text=Check Out New ''Star Wars'' Products Just Revealed for Triple Force Friday|date=2019-09-26}}</ref> It was first identified as "Zorii Bliss's Y-Wing" in the [[w:c:starwarscardtrader:Ships & Vehicles: Age of Resistance|''Ships & Vehicles: Age of Resistance'']] set<ref name="Topps2" />—which was released on [[February 11]], [[2020]]<ref name="ToppsRelease">{{WebCite|url=http://www.toppsbunt.com/swcardtrader/article/5e42beac21d72594f14e040c|text=Ships and Vehicles: Age of the Resistance Debuts Today!|date=2020-02-11|work=[https://play.toppsapps.com Topps Digital]|quote=Grab Wave 1 today!|archiveurl=https://archive.vn/9FVWe|nolive=1}}</ref>—for the [[Star Wars: Card Trader|''Star Wars'': Card Trader]] application,<ref name="Topps2" /> which initially released [[March 12]], [[2015]].<ref name="SWCT release">{{SW|url=news/topps-star-wars-card-trader-app-now-available-exclusive|text=Topps' ''Star Wars'' Card Trader App Now Available - Exclusive!|date=2015-03-12}}</ref> The ship's name was revealed as the ''Comeuppance'' in [[Rae Carson]]'s [[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: Expanded Edition|novelization]] of ''The Rise of Skywalker'',<ref name="TROS Expanded" /> which was published on [[March 17]], 2020.<ref name="ExpandedDate">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/609082/the-rise-of-skywalker-expanded-edition-star-wars-by-rae-carson/9780593128404|text=The Rise of Skywalker: Expanded Edition (Star Wars)}}</ref>

[[File:Comeuppance-AFinalAlliance.png|thumb|right|300px|Keri Russell filming a scene as Zorii Bliss in the ''Comeuppance''.]]
A full-size model was created for the ''Comeuppance'' in ''The Rise of Skywalker'', the first one made since [[1976]]<ref name="Final" /> for the filming of the original film, [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> The model was an update to the ''A New Hope'' version, which was modeled by [[Colin Cantwell]] and designed by [[Joe Johnston]]. Production designer [[Kevin Jenkins]] wanted to return to artist [[Ralph McQuarrie]]'s original designs, which Jenkins described as having a more "rocket ship feeling." The cockpit was removable for filming on a green screen atop a gimbal. [[Keri Russell]], who portrayed Zorii Bliss, remarked how fun it was to be in the cockpit and press a starfighter's buttons. Russell was excited for others to see<ref name="Final" /> her<ref name="KeriPronouns">[[Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga – The Official Collector's Edition|''Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga'' – The Official Collector's Edition]]</ref> in the ship.<ref name="Final" />

[[File:ComeuppancePlaceholder-SWGOH.png|left|thumb|right|225px|Placeholder art for ''Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes'' by "CG_Tusken_Meathead" for the ''Comeuppance'']]
The ''Comeuppance'' was eventually added to the [[EA Capital Games]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes]]''<ref name="GOHAdd">{{EA|subdomain=forums.galaxy-of-heroes.starwars|url=discussion/268007/kit-reveal-comeuppance|text=Kit Reveal - Comeuppance|author=CG_Tusken_Meathead|date=2024-01-16}}</ref>—originally debuted [[November 24]], 2015<ref name="Holotable Master">{{SW|url=news/how-to-become-a-master-of-the-holotables-in-star-wars-galaxy-of-heroes|text=How to Become a Master of the Holotables in ''Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes''|author=[[Cole Horton]]|date=2015-11-24|nolive=1}}</ref>—and was obtainable beginning [[January 19]], [[2024]]. The ''Galaxy of Heroes'' designers were inspired to include the ''Comeuppance'' after they added Bliss to the game the previous [[2023|year]]. The designers took inspiration from Bliss's arrival at the Battle of Exegol and her relationship with Dameron to name the ship's abilities. The forum post announcing the ship's inclusion in the game, posted on [[January 16]],<ref name="GOHAdd" /> featured placeholder art by EA Community Manager "CG_Tusken_Meathead" of the ship with a note stating they were still awaiting approval for the official art.<ref name="Reddit">{{Reddit|url=r/SWGalaxyOfHeroes/comments/198eydi/kit_reveal_comeuppance/ki6r3ay|thread=Kit Reveal: Comeuppance|user=swgohevents|date=2024-01-16|archiveurl=https://archive.is/M1Upe}}</ref> The forum post was updated the [[January 17|next day]] to include the official art.<ref name="GOHAdd2">{{EA|subdomain=forums.galaxy-of-heroes.starwars|url=discussion/comment/2455565|text=Kit Reveal: Comeuppance - Page 2|author=CG_Tusken_Meathead|date=2024-01-17|nolive=1}}</ref>

===Errors and brick-built counterpart===
{{Quote|A second X-wing joined him in the attack, not only replicating his tricky maneuvers but often blasting the pursued TIEs before he could.|An excerpt from the Junior Novel referring to the ''Comeuppance''|audio=ComeuppanceError-TheRiseOfSkywalkerJuniorNovelAudio.flac|<ref name="Jr" />}}
[[File:AlternateComeuppance-StarWarsStarfighterMissions.png|thumb|right|225px|The alternate color scheme for the ''Comeuppance'' in ''Star Wars: Starfighter Missions'']]
In [[Michael Kogge]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: A Junior Novel]]'', the ''Comeuppance'' is mistakenly called an [[X-wing starfighter]].<ref name="Jr" /> The novel was published on [[April 16]], 2020.<ref name="JrRelease">{{Amazon|domain=co.uk|url=Star-Wars-Skywalker-Junior-Novel/dp/1405296542|text=Star Wars The Rise of Skywalker Junior Novel}}</ref> In the [[JOYMAX]] video game ''[[Star Wars: Starfighter Missions]]''<ref name="SFM">''[[Star Wars: Starfighter Missions]]''</ref>—which released [[August 6]], 2020<ref name="Google Play">{{GooglePlay|url=apps/details?id=com.joymax.starwarsstarfighter&hl=en_US|text=Star Wars™: Starfighter Missions|nolive=1}}</ref>—the ''Comeuppance'' had a cosmetic option to change the ship's trim pattern and color to yellow.<ref name="SFM" />

In the non-[[canon]] [[Traveller's Tales]] video game ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]''<ref name="TSS" />—which released [[April 5]], [[2022]]<ref name="TSSRelease">{{SW|url=news/lego-star-wars-the-skywalker-saga-is-here|text=''LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga'' Is Here!|date=2022-04-05|quote=The bricks strike back today.}}</ref>—when Bliss arrives at the Battle of Exegol, the ''Comeuppance'' is a yellow BTL Y-wing. Bliss also refers to a TIE fighter she shoots down as "sky trash" instead of the Star Destroyer, as depicted in ''The Rise of Skywalker''. After Rey interrupts Sidious's [[Force lightning]], Frik takes control of the ''Comeuppance''—whose model was corrected to a red BTA-NR2 Y-wing—and destroys the underbelly of a Destroyer.<ref name="TSS" /> The non-canon reference book ''[[LEGO Star Wars Awesome Vehicles]]'', written by [[Simon Hugo]]<ref name="Awesome">''[[LEGO Star Wars Awesome Vehicles]]''</ref> and released [[June 7]], 2022,<ref name="DK">{{DK|url=us/book/9780744051858-lego-star-wars-awesome-vehicles|text=LEGO Star Wars Awesome Vehicles}}</ref> established the ''Comeuppance'' had [[Sensor dome (ship part)|sensor domes]], could achieve a top speed of 1,050 [[Kilometer per hour|kph]] (652 [[Mile per hour|mph]]), and measured 18.2 [[meter]]s (60 [[Foot|ft]]).<ref name="Awesome" /> According to the non-canon reference book ''[[LEGO Star Wars Visual Dictionary Updated Edition]]'',<ref name="LEGOVD">''[[LEGO Star Wars Visual Dictionary Updated Edition]]''</ref> released [[April 2]], 2024,<ref name="LEGOVD Release">{{DK|url=us/book/9780593845301-lego-star-wars-visual-dictionary-updated-edition|text=LEGO Star Wars Visual Dictionary Updated Edition}}</ref> the ship had a [[torpedo]] bay, rotating [[turret]], and red stripes personalized by Bliss.<ref name="LEGOVD" />
